## `jumbo`

Juntai internal unified build tool

**Usage:** `jumbo [COMMAND]`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `build` — Run the build pipeline (default when no subcommand is given)
* `test` — Run tests (= build test)
* `format` — Run formatting (= build format)
* `release` — Run release pipeline (= build release)
* `clean` — Clean build artifacts (= build clean)
* `workspace` — Manage Jumbo workspace
* `resolve` — Resolve internal dependencies by declared major against the Jumbo index
* `completions` — Generate shell completion scripts



## `jumbo build`

Run the build pipeline (default when no subcommand is given)

**Usage:** `jumbo build [COMMAND]`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `format` — Run formatting
* `release` — Run release pipeline
* `clean` — Clean build artifacts for the current project

## `jumbo workspace`

Manage Jumbo workspace

**Usage:** `jumbo workspace <COMMAND>`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `create` — Create a new Jumbo workspace
* `use` — Clone a repository into the workspace
* `import` — Import an existing local project into the workspace
* `remove` — Remove a project from the workspace (metadata, directory, and IDE config)
* `sync` — Sync workspace configuration with local repositories
* `watch` — Watch workspace and periodically sync
* `clean` — Clean build artifacts for all repositories



## `jumbo workspace create`

Create a new Jumbo workspace

**Usage:** `jumbo workspace create [OPTIONS] <NAME>`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<NAME>` — Workspace name — creates a new folder with this name at the current directory

###### **Options:**

* `-i`, `--import` — Import existing projects folder content (requires <name> folder to already exist)



## `jumbo workspace use`

Clone a repository into the workspace

**Usage:** `jumbo workspace use --repository <REPOSITORY>...`

###### **Options:**

* `-r`, `--repository <REPOSITORY>` — Git repository URL(s) to clone (can be specified multiple times)



## `jumbo workspace import`

Import an existing local project into the workspace

**Usage:** `jumbo workspace import [OPTIONS]`

###### **Options:**

* `-p`, `--project <PROJECT>` — Name(s) of project(s) under projects/ to import. If omitted, all folders under projects/ are imported automatically



## `jumbo workspace remove`

Remove a project from the workspace (metadata, directory, and IDE config)

**Usage:** `jumbo workspace remove [OPTIONS] --project <PROJECT>...`

###### **Options:**

* `-p`, `--project <PROJECT>` — Name(s) of project(s) to remove from the workspace
* `-y`, `--yes` — Skip confirmation prompt and remove immediately (even with pending changes)



## `jumbo workspace sync`

Sync workspace configuration with local repositories

**Usage:** `jumbo workspace sync`



## `jumbo workspace watch`

Watch workspace and periodically sync

**Usage:** `jumbo workspace watch [OPTIONS]`

###### **Options:**

* `-i`, `--interval <INTERVAL>` — Sync interval in seconds

  Default value: `30`



## `jumbo workspace clean`

Clean build artifacts for all repositories

**Usage:** `jumbo workspace clean`



## `jumbo resolve`

Resolve internal dependencies by declared major against the Jumbo index

**Usage:** `jumbo resolve [OPTIONS] [DECLARATION]`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<DECLARATION>` — Declaration to resolve, e.g. `juntai-fuse-api[http]@2` or `@juntai/pkg@^1`

###### **Options:**

* `-m`, `--manifest <PATH>` — Manifest to validate and resolve (pyproject.toml or package.json)
* `-i`, `--index <PATH_OR_URL>` — Jumbo index location: a local clone path or an https://github.com URL (default: JUMBO_INDEX_PATH, then JUMBO_INDEX_URL, then the JumboIndex repository)
* `--check` — Validate declaration forms only; do not look up index records



## `jumbo completions`

Generate shell completion scripts

**Usage:** `jumbo completions <SHELL>`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<SHELL>` — Target shell

  Possible values: `bash`, `elvish`, `fish`, `powershell`, `zsh`
